headline: Profit surges as AI-driven demand lifts full-year outlook
summary_short: Jabil's fiscal Q3 2026 revenue rose 11.8% y/y to $8.75B and GAAP diluted EPS grew 27.6% y/y to $2.59, beating expectations as it raised its full-year FY2026 guidance.
summary_long: Revenue rose 5.7% q/q and 11.8% y/y to $8.75B on strong AI infrastructure demand and better-than-expected Automotive and Connected Living results. GAAP operating income rose 19.0% q/q and 10.4% y/y to $445M; GAAP diluted EPS was $2.59 (+24.5% q/q, +27.6% y/y), and core (non-GAAP) diluted EPS was $3.16. Cash fell to $1.36B from $1.93B at fiscal year-start on acquisition spending (including Hanley Energy Group) and buybacks. Jabil raised its FY2026 outlook to $35B revenue, 5.8% core operating margin, $12.70 core diluted EPS, and $1.4B+ adjusted free cash flow, and guided Q4 FY2026 revenue of $9.2-10.0B and core diluted EPS of $3.80-4.20.
